reason: The old harness prints only the tree returned by cJSON_ParseWithOpts. In the after source, array and object parsing reject a container at the same depth at which array printing would reject it. Both parsing and printing start at depth zero, so no parser-accepted array reaches the new print guard. The old printer also had no depth guard.

scope_contract.reason: Printing parser-produced arrays is within this entry point’s operations.

evidence.dependency_reason: The harness passes its parsed tree to a print function.

feasible_trigger.reason: A parser-produced array cannot have a depth that parsing accepts but the new array printer rejects. Both container parsers check the same limit before increasing depth; parser dispatch creates arrays through parse_array and objects through parse_object.

evidence.dependency_reason: Parser dispatch routes container input to the guarded parsers.
Array parsing rejects depth at the printer’s threshold.
Object parsing applies the same threshold to mixed nesting.
Unbuffered printing initializes depth to zero.
Buffered printing initializes depth to zero.
The harness prints only a parser-returned tree.

observable_consequence.reason: The proposed depth-only print failure cannot occur for an array accepted by this parser.

evidence.dependency_reason: The parser rejects an array before the print guard’s depth can be reached.
The parser likewise rejects an object at that depth.

alternatives_ruled_out.reason: The harness’s ordinary parse-then-print sequence already reaches printing for parser-accepted array depths through both buffered and unbuffered paths.

evidence.dependency_reason: The parser permits only depths below the print guard.
The harness selects buffered or unbuffered printing after a successful parse.

identity_preserved.reason: Both versions assess the same tuple: printing an array returned by this parser at a depth the parser accepted. The before printer had no depth guard; the after printer added one.

evidence.dependency_reason: The same fixed harness supplies the parser-produced tree to printing on both sides.

source_evidence.dependency_reason: Dispatches parsed containers to their guarded parsers.

coverage_witness.supported_behavior: Print a parser-produced array at a nesting depth accepted by parsing.
coverage_witness.required_setup: Supply valid JSON whose array nesting is below CJSON_NESTING_LIMIT.
coverage_witness.actual_target_setup: The harness parses the input, then prints the returned tree through a buffered or unbuffered path.
coverage_witness.blocked_behavior: None for the frozen tuple; parsing rejects container depths that would trigger the new array print guard.
coverage_witness.equivalent_routes: The harness’s existing parse-then-print paths reach the supported behavior.
